Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.description: A public repository of data on scheduled electricity outages in Ukraine.
Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.body:
# outage-data-ua

A public repository and tools for automatically collecting, parsing, visualizing (HTML), and automatically generating PNG images of scheduled and emergency electricity outage charts in Ukraine.

The project fetches data from public web pages of power suppliers and stores it as JSON "as is" in the `data/` directory. This data is then rendered with a fixed HTML template and converted into PNG images, which are saved to `images/<region>/gpv-x-x.png`.

---

## Data format
Each region is stored in a file `data/<region>.json`. Basic structure (abridged):

```json
{
  "regionId": "kyiv",
  "regionAffiliation": "м. Київ",
  "lastUpdated": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z",
  "fact": { "updateFact": "06.11.2025 09:09" },
  "preset": { "updateFact": "04.11.2025 18:00" },
  "lastUpdateStatus": { "status": "parsed", "ok": true, "code": 200, "message": null, "at": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z", "attempt": 5 },
  "meta": { "schemaVersion": "1.0.0", "contentHash": "..." }
}
```

- `preset` — scheduled outages for the week for each group (weekly template). Stored "as is", without structural normalization.
- `fact` — actual and emergency outages for today and tomorrow for each group. Also…

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash

npx cap open ios
```

chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor.description: Hong Kong Immigration Department smart ID card appointment quota monitoring dashboard: detection every 5 minutes, with email/Feishu notifications when slots are released (third-party tool, not official)
chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor.body:
# Hong Kong ID Card Appointment Quota Dashboard

Monitors smart ID card appointment quotas at the six Hong Kong Immigration Department registration offices, checking about every 2 minutes, and reminds subscribers via email / Feishu group when slots are released. **A third-party public-interest tool, not an official Immigration Department service. It only monitors and sends reminders; it does not grab or book appointments on anyone's behalf.**

## Dashboard entry

- **Preferred (stable direct access from mainland China):** https://hkid-quota-monitor.pages.dev/
- Backup: https://chen1111-a.github.io/hkid-quota-monitor/
  (From mainland networks, github.io is intermittently unreachable. jsDelivr/raw direct links carry a nosniff header and only display source code, so do not use them as web entry points.)
- The full experience in mainland China without a VPN is **email subscription + Feishu group**. The notification path is entirely domestic and direct, so slot releases reach your phone immediately; the dashboard is only a helper.

## How it works

```
cron-job.org (every 2 minutes) ──▶ GitHub Actions
                            │  python -m quota_monitor.run
                            │  ├─ fetch the Immigration Department public quota API (read-only, one request per run)
                            │  ├─ diff against previous snapshot → slot-release events
                            │  └─ commit data/ + refresh jsDelivr cache
                            ▼
        index.html dashboard (mobile-first, auto-refreshes every 90 seconds)
        Email + Feishu notifications (triggered by slot-release events, with debounce cooldown)
```

- API structure: [docs/api-notes.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/api-notes.md)
- 2-minute trigger configuration: [docs/cron-setup.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/cron-setup.md)

## Improvements over similar tools

- **Mobile-first:** dates scroll vertically in rows, all 6 offices fit on one screen, no horizontal table scrolling
- **Color-blind friendly:** status cells use both color and text (available / few / full)
- **Notification flood prevention:** the official API has load-balancing data fluctuation (measured: 304↔346 cells swinging within the same minute). The notification layer applies a per-cell cooldown so it doesn't fire every round
- **Direct domestic access:** email subscription and Feishu notification paths are reachable domestically, no circumvention needed
- Light and dark themes; summary cards directly answer "which is the earliest date I can book"

leizongmin/ZeroWeb.description: An experimental cross-platform browser project written in Rust.
leizongmin/ZeroWeb.body:
# ZeroWeb

ZeroWeb is an experimental cross-platform browser written in Rust from scratch, supporting macOS, Linux, Windows, and Android. It delivers two things:

- **`ZeroWebView`**: a web rendering library that can be embedded in other applications
- **`ZeroBrowser`**: a full browser application built on the same engine

The DOM, CSS, layout, rendering, JavaScript bindings, networking, and security boundaries are all implemented in this repository, mainly relying on Rust components under permissive licenses.

This is also an AI-first engineering experiment: humans are responsible only for solution design, key decisions, and result verification, while nearly all the code is written by AI. We want to see how far AI can advance a complex system like a browser when architectural boundaries, tests, and acceptance criteria are clearly defined.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The project is in an experimental stage and **is not a browser for everyday use**. It is suitable for learning, research, and engineering exploration. For commercial or production use, please evaluate the feature, security, compatibility, performance, and licensing risks yourself.

## Why this project

- **Embedding first**: In addition to the browser application, it provides a stable Rust `ZeroWebView` API so other applications can integrate it directly.
- **Clear licensing boundaries**: Mainline dependencies prefer permissive licenses such as MIT, Apache-2.0, and BSD, so core capabilities are not subject to copyleft constraints.
- **Full-stack Rust**: The page engine, host layer, and rendering infrastructure are kept within the Rust ecosystem wherever possible.
- **AI can write, but it must be reviewable**: Every change must be clearly explained, testable, and observable.

## Current status

Status legend: ✅ basic capability available and covered by tests; 🚧 in progress, not yet complete; ⏳ planned.

| Capability | Status | Current state |
|------|------|------|
| Desktop browser | ✅ | Native windows on macOS / Linux / Windows; multiple tabs, address bar, downloads, context menu, zoom, find in page, bookmarks, history, settings |
| Android browser | ✅ | Kotlin/Compose UI + Rust core; multiple tabs, keyboard and input method, downloads, notifications, bilingual Chinese and English |
| Multi-process architecture | ✅ | Rendering, image decoding, and compositing run in separate processes; page scripts run only inside the rendering process |
| Embedding API `ZeroWebView` | ✅ | Stable API and demo, with Service Worker, WASM, and security checks integrated |
| HTML / CSS rendering | 🚧 | Upstream WPT reftests ~95.4% passing (15,830 / 16,590, 2026-11-01) |

xiaour/yolo-data.description: An advanced and stable enterprise-grade intelligent analytics platform; a Data Agent for enterprise data Q&A and insight analysis, built on data analysis methodology to deliver auditable, governable, and reproducible workflows.
xiaour/yolo-data.body:
[English](https://github.com/xiaour/yolo-data/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md) | Simplified Chinese

# YOLO Data Agent | Enterprise Intelligent Data Q&A Platform

A self-service data analysis platform for business teams: ask questions in natural language, get traceable results from data with unified definitions, and keep breaking down, comparing, and analyzing within the same session.

YOLO Data Agent connects agents, metrics and business datasets, permissions, and analysis workspaces into a manageable data Q&A workflow. Business users do not need to write SQL: they can ask questions directly, add conditions, and follow up on results; when key information is unclear, the agent asks for clarification first. Administrators are responsible for connecting data and configuring business topics and authorization scopes, so teams can perform analysis within controlled data boundaries.

The platform does not treat 'a SQL statement generated by a model' as an analysis result: query scope, metric definitions, and permissions are configured by the platform and validated at execution time; results, sessions, and analysis artifacts can be retained to support ongoing work and auditing.

## How It Differs from General-Purpose Agents

General-purpose agents typically target open-ended tasks, with the model choosing tools and actions on the fly; YOLO Data Agent focuses on enterprise data analysis, placing model capabilities within the business semantics, data scopes, and execution rules configured by administrators. The model is responsible for understanding questions, organizing analysis, and interpreting results; the platform decides 'what can be queried, under which definitions, and how results are executed.'

| Comparison dimension | Common approach in general-purpose agents | YOLO Data Agent |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Task scope | Open-ended tasks, flexibly acting based on prompts and available tools | Data Q&A and analysis centered on business topics, metrics, and authorized datasets |
| Data understanding | May rely directly on the model to read schemas and guess field meanings | Administrators configure field semantics, metric definitions, default value domains, and topic scopes |
| Query execution | May be generated by the model, which calls SQL or other data tools | Contract-first: the model proposes structured query intent, and the platform validates and compiles a read-only query; the model never submits raw SQL |
| Permission boundaries | Often handled by prompts, tool configuration, or upstream systems | Topic/metric/dataset authorization and row- and column-level policies are enforced server-side |
| Result continuity | Relies on general conversation context and temporary tool results | Session memory, result snapshots, workspace artifacts, feedback, and auditing are connected into a reviewable analysis workflow |

Therefore, YOLO Data Agent is not meant to replace all general-purpose agent scenarios; instead, it provides a dedicated execution framework for business analysis tasks where 'data definitions must be unified, access must be governed, and conclusions must be traceable.' Skills and MCP extend how it is connected, but they do not bypass the platform's data permissions and query validation.
